description: Per-voltage-class defaults for IEEE 738 line parameters, used only where the CEN technical sheet (ficha tecnica general) of a section lacks the field. Override with --line-defaults FILE or per line with the line-params options.

sources.cen_population: Medians of the certified CEN Infotecnica 'ficha tecnica general' fields over the in-service C1 sections (downloaded 2026-11-25; 220 kV: 314 sections, 300-309 with each field; 500 kV: 17 sections, all fields). 220 kV: conductor family AAAC (AAAC 166, ACAR 61, ACSR 24, AAC 17), section median 402.8 mm2 (quartiles 375-522), 1 conductor per phase in 249/305 (2: 44, 4: 12), design temperature median 75 C (quartiles 56-80; 50 C in 56 sections), R20 median 0.0729 ohm/km. 500 kV: 4 x ACAR 700 MCM in 14/17 (2 per phase in 3), section 355 mm2, design temperature median 65 C (quartiles 60-75), R20 0.022 ohm/km per phase. Source: Coordinador Electrico Nacional, https://infotecnica.coordinador.cl
sources.clearance: Minimum conductor-to-ground clearances: SEC, Pliego Tecnico Normativo RPTD N 07 'Franja y distancias de seguridad' (2020), which replaced NSEG 5 En.71; IEC 60826 / CIGRE TB 601 for typical sag at the design temperature.
sources.ieee738: IEEE Std 738-2012/2023 (conductor temperature and current); CIGRE TB 601 (2014) for emissivity/absorptivity ranges.
sources.cen_fit: Emissivity = absorptivity = 0.5 reproduce the CEN thermal tables of AAAC Flint (Los Vilos - Las Palmas 220 kV) to about 1 %.

220.tower: Lattice steel, single or double circuit, about 30-40 m; attachment of the lowest phase about 22-26 m, sag at design temperature about 8-11 m, so the mean conductor height along a span is about 15-18 m.

500.tower: Lattice steel, single circuit (horizontal or delta) or double circuit, about 40-50 m; attachment about 30-35 m, sag about 12-15 m, mean conductor height about 22-26 m.

notes: Diameter from the section with D = 1.15 sqrt(4 A / pi) (stranded round wire; Flint 375.4 mm2 -> 25.2 mm). r20 is per sub-conductor (CEN gives the per-phase positive-sequence R20). The conductor height has no CEN field: it is the mean height of the lowest phase along a span (attachment height minus about 2/3 of the sag at design temperature). 104 of 143 XLSX structure lists carry a sag column (flecha) but only 8 a height column, so per-span heights are not derived yet.
